column1: # The manual attribution pass (universal-binary REQ-A1.2): every item of the
# mined set that names no layer script, attributed to tiers by reading it.
# Read by scripts/substrate-attribute.sh, which fails on an item naming no
# script without a row here, and on a row for an item that names one.
# Rule applied: a script the text names without its .sh suffix, or a mechanism
# identifiable as one script, takes that script's partition tier; skill prose
# and instruction headroom take skill-called; guards, lint, tests and CI take
# dev-check; hook registrations and settings fragments take hook; shared
